rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior global sourcing role for electronics commodities in home robotics, covering supplier strategy, procurement, contract manufacturing partnerships, cost, and production ramp-up.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- BS in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
- 5+ years of global sourcing experience focused on electronics.
- Experience developing and implementing sourcing strategies that save costs and improve supplier performance.
- Supplier negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- At least 5 years of global sourcing experience focused on electronics commodities, including cameras and contract manufacturing.
- Experience with data analysis and reporting.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
